biggest_catch: Rewards capped at $100 per household and the new account must receive its first direct deposit or paper payroll check within 45 days.
catches: $50 for you and $50 for your friend per qualifying referral.
Harbor Pointe reserves the right to cap member reward contributions at $100.00 per household.
Referrer must be a member in good standing for at least 6 months (no delinquent loans or negative balances).
New member opens a membership account plus checking with direct payroll deposit or first paper payroll check within 45 days of account opening.
Cash awarded at the time of first direct deposit; may be reversed if the new account is closed within the first 6 months.
Membership open to anyone living in St. Louis, Carlton, Lake, East Itasca MN or Douglas County WI; 18+.
Cash award subject to taxes; recipient may receive a 1099; cannot be combined with other promotional offers.
